_comment: HARPS-tuned one-config pipeline example. Latin-Hypercube sample an FGK parameter grid, then synthesize spectra at HARPS resolution, in a single command.
_harps: HARPS = High Accuracy Radial velocity Planet Searcher, the fibre-fed echelle spectrograph on the ESO 3.6 m at La Silla.
Resolving power R ~ 115000 -> synthesis_parameters.resolution = 115000.0 below convolves the output to the instrument profile.
Wavelength coverage 3780-6910 A across two CCDs, with a physical gap at ~5304-5337 A (between the blue and red detectors).

CCD GAP NOTE: this pipeline writes a single contiguous LAMBDA_MIN/MAX/STEP window to bsyn (run_turbospectrum.py); segments_file is NOT wired through the Python wrapper. This example synthesizes the full 3780-6910 A window as one array and does NOT carve out the gap. For detector-faithful spectra, either mask 5304-5337 A downstream, or run two passes - blue CCD lam_min/lam_max = 3780/5304 and red CCD = 5337/6910 - and concatenate.
lam_step = 0.01 A gives ~4 points per resolution element at 5000 A (FWHM ~ 0.043 A). The full window is ~313k wavelength points per spectrum.
Parameter bounds target the bright FGK dwarfs/subgiants typical of HARPS RV programs; widen them for a more general grid.
_usage: 2. Edit:  the four sections below (grid / turbospectrum / outputs / runtime).
Keys starting with '_' are documentation only and are stripped before use.

grid._note: FGK Latin-Hypercube sample plus the HARPS wavelength window. Switch to sampling='grid' + grid.axes for a regular Cartesian grid (see config_regular_grid.example.json).

abundances._note: Each element is either a fixed string ('+0.00') or a {min,max} range added to the Latin Hypercube.

io._note: Canonical compression block shared by every grid path (resolve_grid_io in scripts/generate_grid.py). Omit it entirely to accept these same defaults.

turbospectrum._note: Synthesis runtime. project_root and the output_dir/log_dir/tmp_dir paths default sensibly when empty; see configs/synthesis/config_sample_comprehensive.json for every available field.

paths._paths_note: Inline turbospectrum paths resolve against project_root (the repo root), NOT relative to this file. Leave model_atmosphere_path empty to auto-locate input_files/model_atmospheres/1D/marcs_standard_comp (also handles the nested-extract layout).

nlte._note: Set enabled=true and point nlte_info_file at your SPECIES_LTE_NLTE.dat for NLTE. For per-abundance ASCII departures, add a top-level nlte_ascii_departures block (see config_regular_grid_nlte_fe_intensity.example.json).

provenance._note: Optional tags embedded in outputs; checksums and code/linelist/atmosphere versions auto-fill when the source files are reachable.

outputs._note: Only run_root is required. grid/spectra paths default to outputs/... under run_root (_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_PATHS in scripts/pipeline_from_config.py); set grid_csv / grid_zarr / spectra_zarr / spectra_shard_template here to override.

runtime._note: workers: null = auto (PBS_NCPUS or CPU count). chunk_rows = row chunk of the spectra Zarr. scratch: optional fast-filesystem staging dir.
